---

### Downloads

| File                   | For                                                                            |
| ---------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `MeloDesk-Setup-….exe` | Windows 10/11 installer (recommended)                                          |
| `…-portable.exe`       | Windows, no installation needed: a single file you can run from anywhere       |
| `…-win-x64.zip`        | The same, unpacked: extract it anywhere and run `melodesk.exe` (starts faster) |
| `…-x86_64.AppImage`    | Linux: make it executable (`chmod +x`) and run it                              |
| `…-mac-arm64.dmg`      | macOS on Apple Silicon (M1 and later)                                          |
| `…-mac-x64.dmg`        | macOS on Intel                                                                 |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt`       | Checksums to verify the downloads                                              |

The app is not code-signed yet:

- **Windows** may show **"Windows protected your PC"**. Click **More info → Run anyway**.
- **macOS** may say the app is damaged or from an unidentified developer. Move it to Applications, then run `xattr -cr /Applications/MeloDesk.app` once in Terminal.
